name: Hail
overview: The Scriptures reveal hail as a powerful instrument of God's judgment and sovereignty, vividly demonstrated in the plague of hail upon Egypt where the Lord warned of a grievous hailstorm that would destroy everything left in the fields, both man and beast (Exodus 9:18-22). Those who feared and obeyed God's word protected their servants and cattle by bringing them indoors, while those who disregarded His warning suffered the full consequences (Exodus 9:20-21). The hailstorm, accompanied by thunder and fire, underscores God's authority to execute His will decisively and serves as a tangible display of His power over nature and nations (Exodus 9:23).
